的: of; ~'s (possessive particle); (used after an attribute); (used to form a nominal expression); (used at the end of a declarative sentence for emphasis)
了: (completed action marker); (modal particle indicating change of state, situation now); (modal particle intensifying preceding clause)
是: to be (followed by substantives only); correct; right; true; (respectful acknowledgement of a command) very well; (adverb for emphatic assertion)
你: you (informal, as opposed to courteous 您)
在: to exist; to be alive; (of sb or sth) to be (located) at; (used before a verb to indicate an action in progress)
不: no; not so; (bound form) not; un-
有: to have; there is; (bound form) having; with; -ful; -ed; -al (as in 意 intentional)
他: he; him (used for either sex when the sex is unknown or unimportant); (used before sb's name for emphasis); (used as a meaningless mock object); (literary) other
这: (pronoun) this; these; (bound form) this; the (followed by a noun); (bound form) this; these (followed by a classifier) (in this sense, commonly pr. [zhèi], esp. in Beijing)
个: (classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier); (bound form) individual
说: to speak; to talk; to say; to explain; to comment; to scold; to tell off; (bound form) theory; doctrine
要: to want; to need; to ask for; will; shall; about to; need to; should; if (same as 是)
好: good; appropriate; proper; all right!; (before a verb) easy to
一: one; single; a (article); as soon as
会: can; to have the skill; to know how to; to be likely to; to be sure to; to meet; to get together; meeting; gathering
都: all; both; entirely; (used for emphasis) even; already; (not) at all
对: right; correct; towards; at; for; concerning; regarding; to treat (sb a certain way)
到: to reach; to arrive; to leave for; to go to; to (a place); until (a time); up to (a point); (verb complement indicating arriving at a place or reaching a point)
上: (bound form) up; upper; above; previous; first (of multiple parts); to climb; to get onto; to go up; to attend (class or university)
来: to come; (used as a substitute for a more specific verb); hither (directional complement for motion toward the speaker, as in 回来); ever since (as in 自古以来)
还: still; still in progress; still more; yet
去: to go; to go to (a place); (of a time etc) last; just passed
想: to think (about); to think of; to devise; to think (that); to believe (that); to desire; to want (to)
给: to; for; for the benefit of; to give
没有: haven't; hasn't; doesn't exist; to not have
那: (specifier) that; the; those (colloquial pr. [nèi]); (pronoun) that (referring to persons, things or situations); then (in that case)
看: to see; to look at; to read; to watch; to visit; to call on
做: to make; to produce; to write; to compose; to do; to engage in; to hold (a party etc); (of a person) to be (an intermediary, a good student etc); to become (husband and wife, friends etc)
吧: (modal particle indicating suggestion or surmise); ...right?; ...OK?; ...I presume.
大: big; large; great; older (than another person); eldest (as in 姐); greatly; freely; fully
现在: now; at present; at the moment; modern
多: many; much; too many; in excess; (after a numeral) ... odd; how (to what extent) (Taiwan pr. [duó])
再: again; once more; re-; second; another; then (after sth, and not until then); no matter how ... (followed by an adjective or verb, and then (usually) 也 or 都 for emphasis)
呢: particle indicating that a previously asked question is to be applied to the preceding word ("What about ...?", "And ...?"); particle for inquiring about location ("Where is ...?"); particle signaling a pause, to emphasize the preceding words and allow the listener time to take them on board ("ok?", "are you with me?"); (at the end of a declarative sentence) particle indicating continuation of a state or action
只: grain that has begun to ripen
知道: to know; to become aware of; also pr. [zhī dao]
时候: time; length of time; moment; period
工作: to work; (of a machine) to operate; job; work
家: used in 家伙 and 家俱
爱: to love; to be fond of; to like; affection; to be inclined (to do sth); to tend to (happen)
喜欢: to like; to be fond of
吃: to eat; to consume; to eat at (a cafeteria etc); to eradicate; to destroy; to absorb
新: abbr. for Xinjiang 疆 or Singapore 坡; surname Xin
找: to try to find; to look for; to call on sb; to find
觉得: to think that ...; to feel that ...; to feel (uncomfortable etc)
几: how much; how many; several; a few
见: to see; to meet; to appear (to be sth); to interview
一些: some; a few; a little; (following an adjective) slightly ...er
听: to listen to; to hear; to heed; to obey; a can (loanword from English "tin"); classifier for canned beverages
开: to open (transitive or intransitive); (of ships, vehicles, troops etc) to start; to turn on; to put in operation; to operate; to run; to boil
叫: to shout; to call; to order; to ask
请: to ask; to invite; please (do sth); to treat (to a meal etc)
回: to circle; to go back; to turn around; to answer
岁: variant of 岁, year; years old
号: ordinal number; day of a month; mark; sign
住: to live; to dwell; to stay; to reside
件: item; component; classifier for events, things, clothes etc
您: you (courteous, as opposed to informal 你)
分: to divide; to separate; to distribute; to allocate; to distinguish (good and bad); (bound form) branch of (an organization); sub- (as in 局)
玩: to play; to have fun; to trifle with; toy
正在: just at (that time); right in (that place); right in the middle of (doing sth)
穿: to wear; to put on; to dress; to bore through
早: early; morning; Good morning!; long ago
们: plural marker for pronouns, and nouns referring to individuals
认识: to know; to recognize; to be familiar with; to get acquainted with sb
块: lump; chunk; piece; classifier for pieces of cloth, cake, soap etc; (coll.) classifier for money and currency units
学: to learn; to study; to imitate; science
多少: how much?; how many?; (phone number, student ID etc) what number?
少: few; less; to lack; to be missing
先生: teacher; gentleman; sir; mister (Mr.); husband; (dialect) doctor
男: male; Baron, lowest of five orders of nobility 位
卖: to sell; to betray; to spare no effort; to show off or flaunt
些: classifier indicating a small amount or small number greater than 1: some, a few, several
口: mouth; classifier for things with mouths (people, domestic animals, cannons, wells etc); classifier for bites or mouthfuls
半: half; semi-; incomplete; (after a number) and a half
店: inn; old-style hotel; (bound form) shop; store
元: surname Yuan; the Yuan or Mongol dynasty (1279-1368)
唱: to sing; to call loudly; to chant
大学: the Great Learning, one of the Four Books 四书 in Confucianism
病: illness; disease; to fall ill; defect

看见: to see; to catch sight of
说话: to speak; to say; to talk; to gossip
高兴: happy; glad; willing (to do sth); in a cheerful mood
热: to warm up; to heat up; hot (of weather); heat
睡觉: to go to bed; to sleep
第: (prefix indicating ordinal number, as in 六 "sixth"); (literary) grades in which successful candidates in the imperial examinations were placed; (old) residence of a high official; (literary) but; however
读: to read out; to read aloud; to read; to attend (school); to study (a subject in school); to pronounce

上班: to go to work; to be on duty; to start work; to go to the office
对不起: I'm sorry; excuse me; I beg your pardon; to let (sb) down; to disappoint

好看: good-looking; nice-looking; good (of a movie, book, TV show etc); embarrassed
星期: week; day of the week; Sunday
哪儿: where?; wherever; anywhere; somewhere; (used in rhetorical questions) how can ...?; how could ...?
起床: to get out of bed; to get up
便宜: cheap; inexpensive; small advantages; to let sb off lightly
上学: to go to school; to attend school
